shared_elements: carved low-relief signs/symbols on a stone slab
field of repeated small motifs arranged over the surface
justification: Both are upright carved monuments bearing low-relief symbolic marks including a disc-like circular motif and schematic figural elements, but the correspondence is generic. A shows a strictly ordered scene of small figures beneath a winged disc above many ruled horizontal registers of dense sign-writing, whereas B shows a single massive anthropomorphic body with head, shoulders and torso bearing a few large isolated ornaments (a rosette-like disc, curved bands, paired eye-like shapes) and no register system.
